title: Media Stack
description: Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd, Emby and Immich: service health, library and queue state, request traffic, container resources and logs.

links.title: Security
links.tooltip: Emby failed logins (401) and probes are on the Security dashboard

panels.title: Sonarr
panels.description: exportarr scrape of Sonarr: UP means the exporter reached Sonarr (up{job="sonarr"}).

panels.title: Radarr
panels.description: exportarr scrape of Radarr: UP means the exporter reached Radarr (up{job="radarr"}).

panels.title: SABnzbd
panels.description: exportarr scrape of SABnzbd: UP means the exporter reached SABnzbd (up{job="sabnzbd"}).

panels.title: Emby
panels.description: UP when Emby answered a 2xx/3xx through Traefik in the last 15 minutes, or its container was seen by cAdvisor in the last 2 minutes.

targets.expr: max((sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service="emby@docker",code=~"[23].."}[15m])) > bool 0) or (time() - container_last_seen{name="lilnas-emby-1"} < bool 120)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Immich
panels.description: UP when Immich answered a 2xx/3xx through Traefik in the last 15 minutes, or its container was seen by cAdvisor in the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: Download queue
panels.description: Items in the SABnzbd queue. An idle queue (0) is normal.

panels.title: Download speed
panels.description: Current SABnzbd download speed. 0 while the queue is idle.

panels.title: Missing / wanted
panels.description: Monitored episodes (Sonarr) and movies (Radarr) that are missing and wanted but not downloaded.

panels.title: Free space on media mounts
panels.description: Free bytes on the btrfs mounts that hold the TV library, movie library, downloads and photos, named by lilnas_storage_volume.

panels.title: Disk fill on media mounts
panels.description: Percent used of the same mounts. Orange at 80%, red at 90%.

panels.title: Series
panels.description: Series in the Sonarr library.

panels.title: Episodes
panels.description: Episodes tracked across all series.

panels.title: Downloaded
panels.description: Episodes with a file on disk.

panels.title: Missing
panels.description: Monitored episodes without a file.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: Warnings and errors Sonarr reports on its own health page.

panels.title: Root folder free
panels.description: Free space on the TV root folder (/tv).

panels.title: Monitored vs missing
panels.description: Series monitored/unmonitored and episodes downloaded/missing/cutoff unmet. Exportarr refreshes these about every minute.

panels.title: Sonarr health issues
panels.description: Event-driven: rows appear while Sonarr reports a health warning or error (indexer failures, pending updates, disk space); "none" when healthy.

panels.title: Movies
panels.description: Movies in the Radarr library.

panels.title: Downloaded
panels.description: Movies with a file on disk.

panels.title: Missing
panels.description: Monitored movies without a file.

panels.title: Cutoff unmet
panels.description: Movies whose file is below the quality cutoff.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: Warnings and errors Radarr reports on its own health page.

panels.title: Root folder free
panels.description: Free space on the movies root folder (/movies).

panels.title: Monitored vs missing
panels.description: Movies monitored/unmonitored, downloaded and missing/wanted. Exportarr refreshes these about every minute.

panels.title: Radarr health issues
panels.description: Event-driven: rows appear while Radarr reports a health warning or error (indexer failures, pending updates, disk space); "none" when healthy.

panels.title: State
panels.description: Running or paused. Paused covers both a user pause and the pause-all state.

panels.title: Speed
panels.description: Current download speed.

panels.title: Queue size
panels.description: Items waiting in the queue.

panels.title: Remaining
panels.description: Bytes left to download across the queue.

panels.title: Queue warnings
panels.description: Warnings SABnzbd reports for queued items.

panels.title: Downloaded (range)
panels.description: Bytes downloaded in the selected time range, from the SABnzbd lifetime counter.

panels.title: Download speed
panels.description: Event-driven: the line is above 0 only while SABnzbd is downloading; an idle queue is flat at 0.

panels.title: Queue size and remaining
panels.description: Event-driven: queue items and bytes left. Both are 0 when nothing is queued.

panels.title: Downloaded per day
panels.description: Event-driven: bytes downloaded in the trailing 24 h, in total and per Usenet server. Flat at 0 on days with no downloads.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second through Traefik (service emby@docker), by status code.

panels.title: 4xx responses
panels.description: Client errors per second (404, 499 …). 401 is left out: failed logins are on the Security dashboard.

panels.title: 5xx responses
panels.description: Event-driven: Emby server errors per second. Empty until Emby fails a request.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration at Traefik. Streaming and long-poll requests raise it.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Emby container CPU, 100% = one core. Transcoding shows up as a sustained rise.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Emby container working set.

panels.title: Network out
panels.description: Bytes per second sent by the Emby container (playback traffic).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second through Traefik (service immich@docker), by status code.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: 4xx (client) responses per second.

panels.title: 5xx responses
panels.description: Event-driven: Immich server errors per second. Empty until Immich fails a request.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration at Traefik. Uploads and websocket upgrades pull it up.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Server and machine-learning containers, 100% = one core. Machine learning spikes while Immich indexes new photos.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Server and machine-learning container working set.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Immich users, from immich_users_total (the only business metric Immich exports).

panels.title: Node process memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the Immich API and microservices Node processes (OpenTelemetry host-metrics).

panels.title: Node process CPU
panels.description: CPU of the API and microservices Node processes, user + system (100% = one core).

panels.title: Job queue activity
panels.description: Event-driven: calls per second to the Immich job repository (queue lookups and worker checks), by component. The microservices component runs the background jobs; the series is empty when the telemetry has no calls to report.

panels.title: Job queue call duration
panels.description: Event-driven: mean time in ms of job-repository queue lookups, by component (telemetry histogram sum/count). Empty when no calls happened in the window.

panels.title: Errors and warnings over time
panels.description: Event-driven: lines at error or warning level (or containing error/warn/fatal/exception/failed) per service. Quiet services show no bars.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Event-driven: Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd and Immich log lines that look like errors or warnings.
